title: Fixed Through Bore Body and Four Crown Loops Knitting Spool
description: One newly authored complete empty French-knitting-spool-inspired hand-tool exterior. One model zero scenes; the four loops are subordinate components, not counted assets. Plain generic category interpretation without doll face, lettering, branding, copied product proportions or decoration. No yarn, stitch, separate lifting needle, cord or use demonstration.
